paragraph: Documented policy is own_windows_shown_mismatch_blocks: each report keeps its own window; a common interval is not recomputed; compare is blocked when windows differ. Tests cover a same-window control (distinct included tx, sample sizes, scoped P&L), non-overlapping early/late windows (disjoint tx, different metrics), and a partial-overlap pair sliced from one labelled corpus (intersection is the shared overlap signatures). window_policy records boundaries, included tx, sample sizes, and scoped metrics. The analysis cache key includes the window.
